No PSI pauses occurred in that passing profile; this does not demonstrate dynamic-gate benefit. Budget headroom and exact policy/workload remain part of the operating point.
Idle + parent 1 CPU failed its second arrival window despite passing whole-window metrics; retained as a failure.
PSI-only at 2 CPU actuated refill pauses but failed the target. AIMD + full scheduling made 7/9 actual CPU changes between 1.6 and 2, failed the target and completed 26/50 sandbox jobs.
Protected-Core PSI does not directly protect sandbox-foreground latency; idle at 1 CPU had lower sandbox median latency than PSI-only at 1 CPU.
Two fixed-trace counterbalanced repetitions provide a scoped validation point, not general optimality, production or hard realtime guarantees; no further parameter search in this batch.
